report.explanation: Fixture suggestion for the keyboard reply.

steps.text: keyboard (Enter) submit chain through the review gate

args.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { if (document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-skills-armed')) { const t = document.querySelector("textarea[data-skill-fixture='composer']"); t.value = 'Reply via keyboard'; t.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true })); window.__fixture.record('set-value', { v: t.value, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); return resolve({ value: t.value, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); } if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) { window.__fixture.record('set-value', { v: 'ARM-TIMEOUT', attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); return resolve({ armTimeout: true }); } setTimeout(tick, 100); }; tick(); })

(() => { const t = document.querySelector("textarea[data-skill-fixture='composer']"); t.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), held: window.__fixture.log.filter((e) => e.type === 'gate-hold').length, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 100)); })()

expect.note: Skill-declared advisory gesture: the fixture-keyboard package sets stopDefaultAction: false on its before-submit gate, so in review-before-submit mode the Enter/click gesture is OBSERVED (onGesture) but never blocked - the user's own text posts and no gate-hold is logged. The default (stopDefaultAction omitted/true) hard-holds: see basic-approve-apply. Which way a gate behaves is decided by the skill, not the runtime.
